    datasets.data_center_timelines()
    .assign(
        date=lambda x: pd.to_datetime(x['Date']),
        date_year=lambda x: x['date'].dt.year,

```{python}

def fill_data_center_timeline_forward(df: pd.DataFrame):
    all_dcs = df['Data center'].unique()
    all_years = sorted(df['date_year'].unique())


    multi_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [all_dcs, all_years], names=['Data center', 'date_year']
    )

    unique_end_of_year = df.groupby(['Data center', 'date_year']).agg('last').reset_index()

    return (unique_end_of_year.set_index(['Data center', 'date_year'])
        .reindex(multi_index)
        .groupby(level='Data center')
        .ffill()
        .reset_index()
        .dropna(subset=['owner_clean'])
    )
```

```{python}

def plot_cumulative_cost_by_year_by_owner(df: pd.DataFrame):
    selection = alt.selection_point(fields=['owner_clean'], bind='legend')
    sort_order = df.groupby(["owner_clean", "date_year"]).agg(dict(total_capital_cost='sum')).reset_index().groupby("owner_clean").last().sort_values("total_capital_cost").reset_index()["owner_clean"]
    df = pd.merge(df,pd.Series(sort_order.index, index=sort_order.values, name="sort_order"), how='left', left_on="owner_clean", right_index=True)
    return (
        alt.Chart(
            df.dropna(subset="total_capital_cost")
        )
        .mark_area(point='transparent',)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('date_year:Q').axis(formatType="number",format='d',  values=range(2025,2031)),
            y=alt.Y('sum(total_capital_cost):Q'),
            color=alt.Color('owner_clean' ),
            opacity=alt.when(selection).then(alt.value(0.8)).otherwise(alt.value(0.2)),
            tooltip=['owner_clean:N', 'sum(total_capital_cost):Q' ],
            order=alt.Order('sort_order:Q', sort='descending'),
        )
    ).add_params(selection)

chart = (timelines[timelines['date_year'] >= 2025]
    .pipe(plot_cumulative_cost_by_year_by_owner)
)
chart
```

def year_end_costs_by_data_center(df: pd.DataFrame):
    return (
        df.groupby(["date_year", 'Data center'])
        .agg({'Total capital cost (2025 USD billions)': 'last', 'date': 'count'})
        .reset_index()
    )

def year_end_costs_by_owner(df: pd.DataFrame):
    return (
        df.groupby(["owner_clean", "date_year", 'Data center'])
        .agg({'total_capital_cost': 'sum', 'date': 'count'})
    .reset_index()
